class Ring₃ (R : Type) extends AddGroup₃ R, Monoid₃ R, MulZeroClass R where
  /-- Multiplication is left distributive over addition -/
  left_distrib : ∀ a b c : R, a * (b + c) = a * b + a * c
  /-- Multiplication is right distributive over addition -/
  right_distrib : ∀ a b c : R, (a + b) * c = a * c + b * c

instance {R : Type} [Ring₃ R] : AddCommGroup₃ R :=
{ Ring₃.toAddGroup₃ with
  add_comm := by
    intro a b
    have : a + (a + b + b) = a + (b + a + b) := calc
      a + (a + b + b) = (a + a) + (b + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃, add_assoc₃]
      _ = (1 * a + 1 * a) + (1 * b + 1 * b) := by simp
      _ = (1 + 1) * a + (1 + 1) * b := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (1 + 1) * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.left_distrib]
      _ = 1 * (a + b) + 1 * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (a + b) + (a + b) := by simp
      _ = a + (b + a + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃]
    exact add_right_cancel₃ (add_left_cancel₃ this) }

class Module₁ (R : Type) [Ring₃ R] (M : Type) [AddCommGroup₃ M] extends SMul₃ R M where
  zero_smul : ∀ m : M, (0 : R) • m = 0
  one_smul : ∀ m : M, (1 : R) • m = m
  mul_smul : ∀ (a b : R) (m : M), (a * b) • m = a • b • m
  add_smul : ∀ (a b : R) (m : M), (a + b) • m = a • m + b • m
  smul_add : ∀ (a : R) (m n : M), a • (m + n) = a • m + a • n

instance selfModule (R : Type) [Ring₃ R] : Module₁ R R where
  smul := fun r s ↦ r*s
  zero_smul := zero_mul
  one_smul := one_mul
  mul_smul := mul_assoc₃
  add_smul := Ring₃.right_distrib
  smul_add := Ring₃.left_distrib

def nsmul₁ [Zero M] [Add M] : ℕ → M → M
  | 0, _ => 0
  | n + 1, a => a + nsmul₁ n a

def zsmul₁ {M : Type*} [Zero M] [Add M] [Neg M] : ℤ → M → M
  | Int.ofNat n, a => nsmul₁ n a
  | Int.negSucc n, a => -nsmul₁ n.succ a

instance abGrpModule (A : Type) [AddCommGroup₃ A] : Module₁ ℤ A where
  smul := zsmul₁
  zero_smul := sorry
  one_smul := sorry
  mul_smul := sorry
  add_smul := sorry
  smul_add := sorry

class AddMonoid₄ (M : Type) extends AddSemigroup₃ M, AddZeroClass M where
  /-- Multiplication by a natural number. -/
  nsmul : ℕ → M → M := nsmul₁
  /-- Multiplication by `(0 : ℕ)` gives `0`. -/
  nsmul_zero : ∀ x, nsmul 0 x = 0 := by intros; rfl
  /-- Multiplication by `(n + 1 : ℕ)` behaves as expected. -/
  nsmul_succ : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x), nsmul (n + 1) x = x + nsmul n x := by intros; rfl

instance mySMul {M : Type} [AddMonoid₄ M] : SMul ℕ M := ⟨AddMonoid₄.nsmul⟩

instance (M N : Type) [AddMonoid₄ M] [AddMonoid₄ N] : AddMonoid₄ (M × N) where
  add := fun p q ↦ (p.1 + q.1, p.2 + q.2)
  add_assoc₃ := fun a b c ↦ by ext <;> apply add_assoc₃
  zero := (0, 0)
  zero_add := fun a ↦ by ext <;> apply zero_add
  add_zero := fun a ↦ by ext <;> apply add_zero

instance : AddMonoid₄ ℤ where
  add := (· + ·)
  add_assoc₃ := Int.add_assoc
  zero := 0
  zero_add := Int.zero_add

  left_distrib : ∀ a b c : R, a * (b + c) = a * b + a * c
  /-- Multiplication is right distributive over addition -/
  right_distrib : ∀ a b c : R, (a + b) * c = a * c + b * c

instance {R : Type} [Ring₃ R] : AddCommGroup₃ R :=
{ Ring₃.toAddGroup₃ with
  add_comm := by
    intro a b
    have : a + (a + b + b) = a + (b + a + b) := calc
      a + (a + b + b) = (a + a) + (b + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃, add_assoc₃]
      _ = (1 * a + 1 * a) + (1 * b + 1 * b) := by simp
      _ = (1 + 1) * a + (1 + 1) * b := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (1 + 1) * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.left_distrib]
      _ = 1 * (a + b) + 1 * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (a + b) + (a + b) := by simp
      _ = a + (b + a + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃]
    exact add_right_cancel₃ (add_left_cancel₃ this) }

class Module₁ (R : Type) [Ring₃ R] (M : Type) [AddCommGroup₃ M] extends SMul₃ R M where

  one_smul : ∀ m : M, (1 : R) • m = m

  add_smul : ∀ (a b : R) (m : M), (a + b) • m = a • m + b • m
  smul_add : ∀ (a : R) (m n : M), a • (m + n) = a • m + a • n

instance selfModule (R : Type) [Ring₃ R] : Module₁ R R where
  smul := fun r s ↦ r*s
  zero_smul := zero_mul
  one_smul := one_mul
  mul_smul := mul_assoc₃
  add_smul := Ring₃.right_distrib
  smul_add := Ring₃.left_distrib

def nsmul₁ [Zero M] [Add M] : ℕ → M → M
  | 0, _ => 0
  | n + 1, a => a + nsmul₁ n a

def zsmul₁ {M : Type*} [Zero M] [Add M] [Neg M] : ℤ → M → M
  | Int.ofNat n, a => nsmul₁ n a
  | Int.negSucc n, a => -nsmul₁ n.succ a

  smul := zsmul₁
  zero_smul := sorry
  one_smul := sorry
  mul_smul := sorry
  add_smul := sorry
  smul_add := sorry

class AddMonoid₄ (M : Type) extends AddSemigroup₃ M, AddZeroClass M where
  /-- Multiplication by a natural number. -/
  nsmul : ℕ → M → M := nsmul₁
  /-- Multiplication by `(0 : ℕ)` gives `0`. -/
  nsmul_zero : ∀ x, nsmul 0 x = 0 := by intros; rfl
  /-- Multiplication by `(n + 1 : ℕ)` behaves as expected. -/
  nsmul_succ : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x), nsmul (n + 1) x = x + nsmul n x := by intros; rfl

instance mySMul {M : Type} [AddMonoid₄ M] : SMul ℕ M := ⟨AddMonoid₄.nsmul⟩

instance (M N : Type) [AddMonoid₄ M] [AddMonoid₄ N] : AddMonoid₄ (M × N) where
  add := fun p q ↦ (p.1 + q.1, p.2 + q.2)
  add_assoc₃ := fun a b c ↦ by ext <;> apply add_assoc₃
  zero := (0, 0)
  zero_add := fun a ↦ by ext <;> apply zero_add
  add_zero := fun a ↦ by ext <;> apply add_zero

instance : AddMonoid₄ ℤ where
  add := (· + ·)
  add_assoc₃ := Int.add_assoc
  zero := 0
  zero_add := Int.zero_add
  add_zero := Int.add_zero

  nsmul_zero := Int.zero_mul
  nsmul_succ := fun n m ↦ show (n + 1 : ℤ) * m = m + n * m
    by rw [Int.add_mul, Int.add_comm, Int.one_mul]

{ Ring₃.toAddGroup₃ with
  add_comm := by
    intro a b
    have : a + (a + b + b) = a + (b + a + b) := calc
      a + (a + b + b) = (a + a) + (b + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃, add_assoc₃]
      _ = (1 * a + 1 * a) + (1 * b + 1 * b) := by simp
      _ = (1 + 1) * a + (1 + 1) * b := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (1 + 1) * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.left_distrib]
      _ = 1 * (a + b) + 1 * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (a + b) + (a + b) := by simp
      _ = a + (b + a + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃]
    exact add_right_cancel₃ (add_left_cancel₃ this) }

  /-- Multiplication is left distributive over addition -/

  /-- Multiplication is right distributive over addition -/
  right_distrib : ∀ a b c : R, (a + b) * c = a * c + b * c

instance {R : Type} [Ring₃ R] : AddCommGroup₃ R :=
{ Ring₃.toAddGroup₃ with
  add_comm := by
    intro a b
    have : a + (a + b + b) = a + (b + a + b) := calc
      a + (a + b + b) = (a + a) + (b + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃, add_assoc₃]
      _ = (1 * a + 1 * a) + (1 * b + 1 * b) := by simp
      _ = (1 + 1) * a + (1 + 1) * b := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (1 + 1) * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.left_distrib]
      _ = 1 * (a + b) + 1 * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (a + b) + (a + b) := by simp
      _ = a + (b + a + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃]
    exact add_right_cancel₃ (add_left_cancel₃ this) }

instance {R : Type} [Ring₃ R] : AddCommGroup₃ R :=
{ Ring₃.toAddGroup₃ with
  add_comm := by
    intro a b
    have : a + (a + b + b) = a + (b + a + b) := calc
      a + (a + b + b) = (a + a) + (b + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃, add_assoc₃]
      _ = (1 * a + 1 * a) + (1 * b + 1 * b) := by simp
      _ = (1 + 1) * a + (1 + 1) * b := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (1 + 1) * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.left_distrib]
      _ = 1 * (a + b) + 1 * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (a + b) + (a + b) := by simp
      _ = a + (b + a + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃]
    exact add_right_cancel₃ (add_left_cancel₃ this) }

      _ = 1 * (a + b) + 1 * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (a + b) + (a + b) := by simp
      _ = a + (b + a + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃]

    intro a b
    have : a + (a + b + b) = a + (b + a + b) := calc
      a + (a + b + b) = (a + a) + (b + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃, add_assoc₃]
      _ = (1 * a + 1 * a) + (1 * b + 1 * b) := by simp
      _ = (1 + 1) * a + (1 + 1) * b := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]

      _ = 1 * (a + b) + 1 * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (a + b) + (a + b) := by simp
      _ = a + (b + a + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃]

instance {R : Type} [Ring₃ R] : AddCommGroup₃ R :=
{ Ring₃.toAddGroup₃ with
  add_comm := by
    intro a b
    have : a + (a + b + b) = a + (b + a + b) := calc
      a + (a + b + b) = (a + a) + (b + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃, add_assoc₃]
      _ = (1 * a + 1 * a) + (1 * b + 1 * b) := by simp
      _ = (1 + 1) * a + (1 + 1) * b := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (1 + 1) * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.left_distrib]
      _ = 1 * (a + b) + 1 * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (a + b) + (a + b) := by simp
      _ = a + (b + a + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃]
    exact add_right_cancel₃ (add_left_cancel₃ this) }

{ Ring₃.toAddGroup₃ with
  add_comm := by
    intro a b
    have : a + (a + b + b) = a + (b + a + b) := calc
      a + (a + b + b) = (a + a) + (b + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃, add_assoc₃]
      _ = (1 * a + 1 * a) + (1 * b + 1 * b) := by simp
      _ = (1 + 1) * a + (1 + 1) * b := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (1 + 1) * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.left_distrib]
      _ = 1 * (a + b) + 1 * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (a + b) + (a + b) := by simp
      _ = a + (b + a + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃]

  /-- Multiplication is left distributive over addition -/
  left_distrib : ∀ a b c : R, a * (b + c) = a * b + a * c
  /-- Multiplication is right distributive over addition -/
  right_distrib : ∀ a b c : R, (a + b) * c = a * c + b * c

instance {R : Type} [Ring₃ R] : AddCommGroup₃ R :=
{ Ring₃.toAddGroup₃ with
  add_comm := by
    intro a b
    have : a + (a + b + b) = a + (b + a + b) := calc
      a + (a + b + b) = (a + a) + (b + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃, add_assoc₃]
      _ = (1 * a + 1 * a) + (1 * b + 1 * b) := by simp
      _ = (1 + 1) * a + (1 + 1) * b := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (1 + 1) * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.left_distrib]
      _ = 1 * (a + b) + 1 * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (a + b) + (a + b) := by simp
      _ = a + (b + a + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃]
    exact add_right_cancel₃ (add_left_cancel₃ this) }

  | Int.negSucc n, a => -nsmul₁ n.succ a

  /-- Multiplication is left distributive over addition -/

  /-- Multiplication is right distributive over addition -/
  right_distrib : ∀ a b c : R, (a + b) * c = a * c + b * c

instance {R : Type} [Ring₃ R] : AddCommGroup₃ R :=
{ Ring₃.toAddGroup₃ with
  add_comm := by
    intro a b
    have : a + (a + b + b) = a + (b + a + b) := calc
      a + (a + b + b) = (a + a) + (b + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃, add_assoc₃]
      _ = (1 * a + 1 * a) + (1 * b + 1 * b) := by simp
      _ = (1 + 1) * a + (1 + 1) * b := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (1 + 1) * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.left_distrib]
      _ = 1 * (a + b) + 1 * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (a + b) + (a + b) := by simp
      _ = a + (b + a + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃]
    exact add_right_cancel₃ (add_left_cancel₃ this) }

  | Int.negSucc n, a => -nsmul₁ n.succ a

  /-- Multiplication by `(n + 1 : ℕ)` behaves as expected. -/
  nsmul_succ : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x), nsmul (n + 1) x = x + nsmul n x := by intros; rfl

class Ring₃ (R : Type) extends AddGroup₃ R, Monoid₃ R, MulZeroClass R where
  /-- Multiplication is left distributive over addition -/
  left_distrib : ∀ a b c : R, a * (b + c) = a * b + a * c
  /-- Multiplication is right distributive over addition -/
  right_distrib : ∀ a b c : R, (a + b) * c = a * c + b * c

instance {R : Type} [Ring₃ R] : AddCommGroup₃ R :=
{ Ring₃.toAddGroup₃ with
  add_comm := by
    intro a b
    have : a + (a + b + b) = a + (b + a + b) := calc
      a + (a + b + b) = (a + a) + (b + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃, add_assoc₃]
      _ = (1 * a + 1 * a) + (1 * b + 1 * b) := by simp
      _ = (1 + 1) * a + (1 + 1) * b := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (1 + 1) * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.left_distrib]
      _ = 1 * (a + b) + 1 * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (a + b) + (a + b) := by simp
      _ = a + (b + a + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃]
    exact add_right_cancel₃ (add_left_cancel₃ this) }

class Module₁ (R : Type) [Ring₃ R] (M : Type) [AddCommGroup₃ M] extends SMul₃ R M where

  one_smul : ∀ m : M, (1 : R) • m = m
  mul_smul : ∀ (a b : R) (m : M), (a * b) • m = a • b • m
  add_smul : ∀ (a b : R) (m : M), (a + b) • m = a • m + b • m
  smul_add : ∀ (a : R) (m n : M), a • (m + n) = a • m + a • n

instance selfModule (R : Type) [Ring₃ R] : Module₁ R R where
  smul := fun r s ↦ r*s
  zero_smul := zero_mul
  one_smul := one_mul
  mul_smul := mul_assoc₃
  add_smul := Ring₃.right_distrib
  smul_add := Ring₃.left_distrib

def nsmul₁ [Zero M] [Add M] : ℕ → M → M

  | n + 1, a => a + nsmul₁ n a

def zsmul₁ {M : Type*} [Zero M] [Add M] [Neg M] : ℤ → M → M

  | Int.negSucc n, a => -nsmul₁ n.succ a

instance abGrpModule (A : Type) [AddCommGroup₃ A] : Module₁ ℤ A where
  smul := zsmul₁
  zero_smul := sorry
  one_smul := sorry
  mul_smul := sorry
  add_smul := sorry
  smul_add := sorry

class AddMonoid₄ (M : Type) extends AddSemigroup₃ M, AddZeroClass M where
  /-- Multiplication by a natural number. -/
  nsmul : ℕ → M → M := nsmul₁

  nsmul_zero : ∀ x, nsmul 0 x = 0 := by intros; rfl
  /-- Multiplication by `(n + 1 : ℕ)` behaves as expected. -/
  nsmul_succ : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x), nsmul (n + 1) x = x + nsmul n x := by intros; rfl

instance mySMul {M : Type} [AddMonoid₄ M] : SMul ℕ M := ⟨AddMonoid₄.nsmul⟩

instance (M N : Type) [AddMonoid₄ M] [AddMonoid₄ N] : AddMonoid₄ (M × N) where
  add := fun p q ↦ (p.1 + q.1, p.2 + q.2)
  add_assoc₃ := fun a b c ↦ by ext <;> apply add_assoc₃
  zero := (0, 0)
  zero_add := fun a ↦ by ext <;> apply zero_add
  add_zero := fun a ↦ by ext <;> apply add_zero

instance : AddMonoid₄ ℤ where
  add := (· + ·)
  add_assoc₃ := Int.add_assoc
  zero := 0
  zero_add := Int.zero_add
  add_zero := Int.add_zero
  nsmul := fun n m ↦ (n : ℤ) * m
  nsmul_zero := Int.zero_mul
  nsmul_succ := fun n m ↦ show (n + 1 : ℤ) * m = m + n * m

instance {R : Type} [Ring₃ R] : AddCommGroup₃ R :=
{ Ring₃.toAddGroup₃ with
  add_comm := by
    intro a b
    have : a + (a + b + b) = a + (b + a + b) := calc
      a + (a + b + b) = (a + a) + (b + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃, add_assoc₃]
      _ = (1 * a + 1 * a) + (1 * b + 1 * b) := by simp
      _ = (1 + 1) * a + (1 + 1) * b := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (1 + 1) * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.left_distrib]
      _ = 1 * (a + b) + 1 * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (a + b) + (a + b) := by simp
      _ = a + (b + a + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃]
    exact add_right_cancel₃ (add_left_cancel₃ this) }

  | Int.negSucc n, a => -nsmul₁ n.succ a

  nsmul_succ : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x), nsmul (n + 1) x = x + nsmul n x := by intros; rfl

class Ring₃ (R : Type) extends AddGroup₃ R, Monoid₃ R, MulZeroClass R where
  /-- Multiplication is left distributive over addition -/
  left_distrib : ∀ a b c : R, a * (b + c) = a * b + a * c
  /-- Multiplication is right distributive over addition -/
  right_distrib : ∀ a b c : R, (a + b) * c = a * c + b * c

instance {R : Type} [Ring₃ R] : AddCommGroup₃ R :=
{ Ring₃.toAddGroup₃ with
  add_comm := by
    intro a b
    have : a + (a + b + b) = a + (b + a + b) := calc
      a + (a + b + b) = (a + a) + (b + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃, add_assoc₃]
      _ = (1 * a + 1 * a) + (1 * b + 1 * b) := by simp
      _ = (1 + 1) * a + (1 + 1) * b := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (1 + 1) * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.left_distrib]
      _ = 1 * (a + b) + 1 * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (a + b) + (a + b) := by simp
      _ = a + (b + a + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃]
    exact add_right_cancel₃ (add_left_cancel₃ this) }

  one_smul : ∀ m : M, (1 : R) • m = m
  mul_smul : ∀ (a b : R) (m : M), (a * b) • m = a • b • m
  add_smul : ∀ (a b : R) (m : M), (a + b) • m = a • m + b • m
  smul_add : ∀ (a : R) (m n : M), a • (m + n) = a • m + a • n

  smul := fun r s ↦ r*s
  zero_smul := zero_mul
  one_smul := one_mul
  mul_smul := mul_assoc₃
  add_smul := Ring₃.right_distrib
  smul_add := Ring₃.left_distrib

def nsmul₁ [Zero M] [Add M] : ℕ → M → M
  | 0, _ => 0
  | n + 1, a => a + nsmul₁ n a

  | Int.ofNat n, a => nsmul₁ n a
  | Int.negSucc n, a => -nsmul₁ n.succ a

  smul := zsmul₁
  zero_smul := sorry
  one_smul := sorry
  mul_smul := sorry
  add_smul := sorry
  smul_add := sorry

  /-- Multiplication by `(n + 1 : ℕ)` behaves as expected. -/
  nsmul_succ : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x), nsmul (n + 1) x = x + nsmul n x := by intros; rfl

{ Ring₃.toAddGroup₃ with
  add_comm := by
    intro a b
    have : a + (a + b + b) = a + (b + a + b) := calc
      a + (a + b + b) = (a + a) + (b + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃, add_assoc₃]
      _ = (1 * a + 1 * a) + (1 * b + 1 * b) := by simp
      _ = (1 + 1) * a + (1 + 1) * b := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (1 + 1) * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.left_distrib]
      _ = 1 * (a + b) + 1 * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (a + b) + (a + b) := by simp
      _ = a + (b + a + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃]
    exact add_right_cancel₃ (add_left_cancel₃ this) }

class Ring₃ (R : Type) extends AddGroup₃ R, Monoid₃ R, MulZeroClass R where
  /-- Multiplication is left distributive over addition -/
  left_distrib : ∀ a b c : R, a * (b + c) = a * b + a * c
  /-- Multiplication is right distributive over addition -/
  right_distrib : ∀ a b c : R, (a + b) * c = a * c + b * c

instance {R : Type} [Ring₃ R] : AddCommGroup₃ R :=
{ Ring₃.toAddGroup₃ with
  add_comm := by
    intro a b
    have : a + (a + b + b) = a + (b + a + b) := calc
      a + (a + b + b) = (a + a) + (b + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃, add_assoc₃]
      _ = (1 * a + 1 * a) + (1 * b + 1 * b) := by simp
      _ = (1 + 1) * a + (1 + 1) * b := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (1 + 1) * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.left_distrib]
      _ = 1 * (a + b) + 1 * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (a + b) + (a + b) := by simp
      _ = a + (b + a + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃]
    exact add_right_cancel₃ (add_left_cancel₃ this) }

  one_smul : ∀ m : M, (1 : R) • m = m
  mul_smul : ∀ (a b : R) (m : M), (a * b) • m = a • b • m
  add_smul : ∀ (a b : R) (m : M), (a + b) • m = a • m + b • m
  smul_add : ∀ (a : R) (m n : M), a • (m + n) = a • m + a • n

  smul := fun r s ↦ r*s
  zero_smul := zero_mul
  one_smul := one_mul
  mul_smul := mul_assoc₃
  add_smul := Ring₃.right_distrib
  smul_add := Ring₃.left_distrib

  | 0, _ => 0
  | n + 1, a => a + nsmul₁ n a

  | Int.ofNat n, a => nsmul₁ n a
  | Int.negSucc n, a => -nsmul₁ n.succ a

  smul := zsmul₁
  zero_smul := sorry
  one_smul := sorry
  mul_smul := sorry
  add_smul := sorry
  smul_add := sorry

  /-- Multiplication by `(n + 1 : ℕ)` behaves as expected. -/
  nsmul_succ : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x), nsmul (n + 1) x = x + nsmul n x := by intros; rfl

class Ring₃ (R : Type) extends AddGroup₃ R, Monoid₃ R, MulZeroClass R where
  /-- Multiplication is left distributive over addition -/
  left_distrib : ∀ a b c : R, a * (b + c) = a * b + a * c
  /-- Multiplication is right distributive over addition -/
  right_distrib : ∀ a b c : R, (a + b) * c = a * c + b * c

instance {R : Type} [Ring₃ R] : AddCommGroup₃ R :=
{ Ring₃.toAddGroup₃ with
  add_comm := by
    intro a b
    have : a + (a + b + b) = a + (b + a + b) := calc
      a + (a + b + b) = (a + a) + (b + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃, add_assoc₃]
      _ = (1 * a + 1 * a) + (1 * b + 1 * b) := by simp
      _ = (1 + 1) * a + (1 + 1) * b := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (1 + 1) * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.left_distrib]
      _ = 1 * (a + b) + 1 * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (a + b) + (a + b) := by simp
      _ = a + (b + a + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃]
    exact add_right_cancel₃ (add_left_cancel₃ this) }

      a + (a + b + b) = (a + a) + (b + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃, add_assoc₃]

{ Ring₃.toAddGroup₃ with
  add_comm := by
    intro a b
    have : a + (a + b + b) = a + (b + a + b) := calc
      a + (a + b + b) = (a + a) + (b + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃, add_assoc₃]
      _ = (1 * a + 1 * a) + (1 * b + 1 * b) := by simp
      _ = (1 + 1) * a + (1 + 1) * b := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (1 + 1) * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.left_distrib]
      _ = 1 * (a + b) + 1 * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (a + b) + (a + b) := by simp
      _ = a + (b + a + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃]
    exact add_right_cancel₃ (add_left_cancel₃ this) }

  add_smul := Ring₃.right_distrib

  | n + 1, a => a + nsmul₁ n a

  | Int.negSucc n, a => -nsmul₁ n.succ a

class AddMonoid₄ (M : Type) extends AddSemigroup₃ M, AddZeroClass M where
  /-- Multiplication by a natural number. -/
  nsmul : ℕ → M → M := nsmul₁

  nsmul_zero : ∀ x, nsmul 0 x = 0 := by intros; rfl
  /-- Multiplication by `(n + 1 : ℕ)` behaves as expected. -/
  nsmul_succ : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x), nsmul (n + 1) x = x + nsmul n x := by intros; rfl

  add := fun p q ↦ (p.1 + q.1, p.2 + q.2)
  add_assoc₃ := fun a b c ↦ by ext <;> apply add_assoc₃
  zero := (0, 0)
  zero_add := fun a ↦ by ext <;> apply zero_add
  add_zero := fun a ↦ by ext <;> apply add_zero

  add := (· + ·)
  add_assoc₃ := Int.add_assoc

  add_zero := Int.add_zero

  nsmul_zero := Int.zero_mul
  nsmul_succ := fun n m ↦ show (n + 1 : ℤ) * m = m + n * m
    by rw [Int.add_mul, Int.add_comm, Int.one_mul]

C1_dependencies.content:
/--
`rfl : a = a` is the unique constructor of the equality type. This is the
same as `Eq.refl` except that it takes `a` implicitly instead of explicitly.

This is a more powerful theorem than it may appear at first, because although
the statement of the theorem is `a = a`, Lean will allow anything that is
definitionally equal to that type. So, for instance, `2 + 2 = 4` is proven in
Lean by `rfl`, because both sides are the same up to definitional equality.
-/
@[match_pattern] def rfl {α : Sort u} {a : α} : Eq a a := Eq.refl a

{ Ring₃.toAddGroup₃ with
  add_comm := by
    intro a b
    have : a + (a + b + b) = a + (b + a + b) := calc
      a + (a + b + b) = (a + a) + (b + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃, add_assoc₃]
      _ = (1 * a + 1 * a) + (1 * b + 1 * b) := by simp
      _ = (1 + 1) * a + (1 + 1) * b := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (1 + 1) * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.left_distrib]
      _ = 1 * (a + b) + 1 * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (a + b) + (a + b) := by simp
      _ = a + (b + a + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃]
    exact add_right_cancel₃ (add_left_cancel₃ this) }

{ Ring₃.toAddGroup₃ with
  add_comm := by
    intro a b
    have : a + (a + b + b) = a + (b + a + b) := calc
      a + (a + b + b) = (a + a) + (b + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃, add_assoc₃]
      _ = (1 * a + 1 * a) + (1 * b + 1 * b) := by simp
      _ = (1 + 1) * a + (1 + 1) * b := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (1 + 1) * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.left_distrib]
      _ = 1 * (a + b) + 1 * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (a + b) + (a + b) := by simp
      _ = a + (b + a + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃]
    exact add_right_cancel₃ (add_left_cancel₃ this) }

class Ring₃ (R : Type) extends AddGroup₃ R, Monoid₃ R, MulZeroClass R where
  /-- Multiplication is left distributive over addition -/
  left_distrib : ∀ a b c : R, a * (b + c) = a * b + a * c
  /-- Multiplication is right distributive over addition -/
  right_distrib : ∀ a b c : R, (a + b) * c = a * c + b * c

instance {R : Type} [Ring₃ R] : AddCommGroup₃ R :=
{ Ring₃.toAddGroup₃ with
  add_comm := by
    intro a b
    have : a + (a + b + b) = a + (b + a + b) := calc
      a + (a + b + b) = (a + a) + (b + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃, add_assoc₃]
      _ = (1 * a + 1 * a) + (1 * b + 1 * b) := by simp
      _ = (1 + 1) * a + (1 + 1) * b := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (1 + 1) * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.left_distrib]
      _ = 1 * (a + b) + 1 * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (a + b) + (a + b) := by simp
      _ = a + (b + a + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃]
    exact add_right_cancel₃ (add_left_cancel₃ this) }

class Module₁ (R : Type) [Ring₃ R] (M : Type) [AddCommGroup₃ M] extends SMul₃ R M where
  zero_smul : ∀ m : M, (0 : R) • m = 0
  one_smul : ∀ m : M, (1 : R) • m = m
  mul_smul : ∀ (a b : R) (m : M), (a * b) • m = a • b • m
  add_smul : ∀ (a b : R) (m : M), (a + b) • m = a • m + b • m
  smul_add : ∀ (a : R) (m n : M), a • (m + n) = a • m + a • n

instance selfModule (R : Type) [Ring₃ R] : Module₁ R R where
  smul := fun r s ↦ r*s
  zero_smul := zero_mul
  one_smul := one_mul
  mul_smul := mul_assoc₃
  add_smul := Ring₃.right_distrib
  smul_add := Ring₃.left_distrib

def nsmul₁ [Zero M] [Add M] : ℕ → M → M
  | 0, _ => 0
  | n + 1, a => a + nsmul₁ n a

def zsmul₁ {M : Type*} [Zero M] [Add M] [Neg M] : ℤ → M → M
  | Int.ofNat n, a => nsmul₁ n a
  | Int.negSucc n, a => -nsmul₁ n.succ a

instance abGrpModule (A : Type) [AddCommGroup₃ A] : Module₁ ℤ A where
  smul := zsmul₁
  zero_smul := sorry
  one_smul := sorry
  mul_smul := sorry
  add_smul := sorry
  smul_add := sorry

#synth Module₁ ℤ ℤ -- abGrpModule ℤ


class AddMonoid₄ (M : Type) extends AddSemigroup₃ M, AddZeroClass M where
  /-- Multiplication by a natural number. -/
  nsmul : ℕ → M → M := nsmul₁
  /-- Multiplication by `(0 : ℕ)` gives `0`. -/
  nsmul_zero : ∀ x, nsmul 0 x = 0 := by intros; rfl
  /-- Multiplication by `(n + 1 : ℕ)` behaves as expected. -/
  nsmul_succ : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x), nsmul (n + 1) x = x + nsmul n x := by intros; rfl

instance mySMul {M : Type} [AddMonoid₄ M] : SMul ℕ M := ⟨AddMonoid₄.nsmul⟩

instance (M N : Type) [AddMonoid₄ M] [AddMonoid₄ N] : AddMonoid₄ (M × N) where
  add := fun p q ↦ (p.1 + q.1, p.2 + q.2)
  add_assoc₃ := fun a b c ↦ by ext <;> apply add_assoc₃
  zero := (0, 0)
  zero_add := fun a ↦ by ext <;> apply zero_add
  add_zero := fun a ↦ by ext <;> apply add_zero

  add := (· + ·)
  add_assoc₃ := Int.add_assoc

  nsmul_succ := fun n m ↦ show (n + 1 : ℤ) * m = m + n * m
    by rw [Int.add_mul, Int.add_comm, Int.one_mul]

protected theorem add_assoc : ∀ a b c : Int, a + b + c = a + (b + c)
  | (m:Nat), (n:Nat), _ => aux1 ..
  | Nat.cast m, b, Nat.cast k => by
    rw [Int.add_comm, ← aux1, Int.add_comm k, aux1, Int.add_comm b]
  | a, (n:Nat), (k:Nat) => by
    rw [Int.add_comm, Int.add_comm a, ← aux1, Int.add_comm a, Int.add_comm k]
  | -[_+1], -[_+1], (k:Nat) => aux2 ..
  | -[m+1], (n:Nat), -[k+1] => by
    rw [Int.add_comm, ← aux2, Int.add_comm n, ← aux2, Int.add_comm -[m+1]]
  | (m:Nat), -[n+1], -[k+1] => by
    rw [Int.add_comm, Int.add_comm m, Int.add_comm m, ← aux2, Int.add_comm -[k+1]]
  | -[m+1], -[n+1], -[k+1] => by
    simp [Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_left_comm, Nat.add_assoc]
where
  aux1 (m n : Nat) : ∀ c : Int, m + n + c = m + (n + c)
    | (k:Nat) => by simp [Nat.add_assoc]
    | -[k+1]  => by simp [subNatNat_add]
  aux2 (m n k : Nat) : -[m+1] + -[n+1] + k = -[m+1] + (-[n+1] + k) := by
    simp
    rw [Int.add_comm, subNatNat_add_negSucc]
    simp [Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_left_comm, Nat.add_assoc]

    rw [Int.add_comm, ← aux1, Int.add_comm k, aux1, Int.add_comm b]
  | a, (n:Nat), (k:Nat) => by

  /-- Multiplication is left distributive over addition -/
  left_distrib : ∀ a b c : R, a * (b + c) = a * b + a * c
  /-- Multiplication is right distributive over addition -/
  right_distrib : ∀ a b c : R, (a + b) * c = a * c + b * c

instance {R : Type} [Ring₃ R] : AddCommGroup₃ R :=
{ Ring₃.toAddGroup₃ with
  add_comm := by
    intro a b
    have : a + (a + b + b) = a + (b + a + b) := calc
      a + (a + b + b) = (a + a) + (b + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃, add_assoc₃]
      _ = (1 * a + 1 * a) + (1 * b + 1 * b) := by simp
      _ = (1 + 1) * a + (1 + 1) * b := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (1 + 1) * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.left_distrib]
      _ = 1 * (a + b) + 1 * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (a + b) + (a + b) := by simp
      _ = a + (b + a + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃]
    exact add_right_cancel₃ (add_left_cancel₃ this) }

instance {R : Type} [Ring₃ R] : AddCommGroup₃ R :=
{ Ring₃.toAddGroup₃ with
  add_comm := by
    intro a b
    have : a + (a + b + b) = a + (b + a + b) := calc
      a + (a + b + b) = (a + a) + (b + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃, add_assoc₃]
      _ = (1 * a + 1 * a) + (1 * b + 1 * b) := by simp
      _ = (1 + 1) * a + (1 + 1) * b := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (1 + 1) * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.left_distrib]
      _ = 1 * (a + b) + 1 * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (a + b) + (a + b) := by simp
      _ = a + (b + a + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃]
    exact add_right_cancel₃ (add_left_cancel₃ this) }

  /-- Multiplication is left distributive over addition -/
  left_distrib : ∀ a b c : R, a * (b + c) = a * b + a * c
  /-- Multiplication is right distributive over addition -/
  right_distrib : ∀ a b c : R, (a + b) * c = a * c + b * c

instance {R : Type} [Ring₃ R] : AddCommGroup₃ R :=
{ Ring₃.toAddGroup₃ with
  add_comm := by
    intro a b
    have : a + (a + b + b) = a + (b + a + b) := calc
      a + (a + b + b) = (a + a) + (b + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃, add_assoc₃]
      _ = (1 * a + 1 * a) + (1 * b + 1 * b) := by simp
      _ = (1 + 1) * a + (1 + 1) * b := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (1 + 1) * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.left_distrib]
      _ = 1 * (a + b) + 1 * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (a + b) + (a + b) := by simp
      _ = a + (b + a + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃]
    exact add_right_cancel₃ (add_left_cancel₃ this) }

instance {R : Type} [Ring₃ R] : AddCommGroup₃ R :=
{ Ring₃.toAddGroup₃ with
  add_comm := by
    intro a b
    have : a + (a + b + b) = a + (b + a + b) := calc
      a + (a + b + b) = (a + a) + (b + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃, add_assoc₃]
      _ = (1 * a + 1 * a) + (1 * b + 1 * b) := by simp
      _ = (1 + 1) * a + (1 + 1) * b := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (1 + 1) * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.left_distrib]
      _ = 1 * (a + b) + 1 * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (a + b) + (a + b) := by simp
      _ = a + (b + a + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃]
    exact add_right_cancel₃ (add_left_cancel₃ this) }

  /-- Multiplication is left distributive over addition -/

  /-- Multiplication is right distributive over addition -/
  right_distrib : ∀ a b c : R, (a + b) * c = a * c + b * c

instance {R : Type} [Ring₃ R] : AddCommGroup₃ R :=
{ Ring₃.toAddGroup₃ with
  add_comm := by
    intro a b
    have : a + (a + b + b) = a + (b + a + b) := calc
      a + (a + b + b) = (a + a) + (b + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃, add_assoc₃]
      _ = (1 * a + 1 * a) + (1 * b + 1 * b) := by simp
      _ = (1 + 1) * a + (1 + 1) * b := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (1 + 1) * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.left_distrib]
      _ = 1 * (a + b) + 1 * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (a + b) + (a + b) := by simp
      _ = a + (b + a + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃]
    exact add_right_cancel₃ (add_left_cancel₃ this) }

  one_smul : ∀ m : M, (1 : R) • m = m

  add_smul : ∀ (a b : R) (m : M), (a + b) • m = a • m + b • m

  one_smul := one_mul

  add_smul := Ring₃.right_distrib
  smul_add := Ring₃.left_distrib

  | 0, _ => 0
  | n + 1, a => a + nsmul₁ n a

  | Int.ofNat n, a => nsmul₁ n a
  | Int.negSucc n, a => -nsmul₁ n.succ a

class Ring₃ (R : Type) extends AddGroup₃ R, Monoid₃ R, MulZeroClass R where
  /-- Multiplication is left distributive over addition -/
  left_distrib : ∀ a b c : R, a * (b + c) = a * b + a * c
  /-- Multiplication is right distributive over addition -/
  right_distrib : ∀ a b c : R, (a + b) * c = a * c + b * c

instance {R : Type} [Ring₃ R] : AddCommGroup₃ R :=
{ Ring₃.toAddGroup₃ with
  add_comm := by
    intro a b
    have : a + (a + b + b) = a + (b + a + b) := calc
      a + (a + b + b) = (a + a) + (b + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃, add_assoc₃]
      _ = (1 * a + 1 * a) + (1 * b + 1 * b) := by simp
      _ = (1 + 1) * a + (1 + 1) * b := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (1 + 1) * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.left_distrib]
      _ = 1 * (a + b) + 1 * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (a + b) + (a + b) := by simp
      _ = a + (b + a + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃]
    exact add_right_cancel₃ (add_left_cancel₃ this) }

class Module₁ (R : Type) [Ring₃ R] (M : Type) [AddCommGroup₃ M] extends SMul₃ R M where
  zero_smul : ∀ m : M, (0 : R) • m = 0
  one_smul : ∀ m : M, (1 : R) • m = m
  mul_smul : ∀ (a b : R) (m : M), (a * b) • m = a • b • m
  add_smul : ∀ (a b : R) (m : M), (a + b) • m = a • m + b • m
  smul_add : ∀ (a : R) (m n : M), a • (m + n) = a • m + a • n

instance selfModule (R : Type) [Ring₃ R] : Module₁ R R where
  smul := fun r s ↦ r*s
  zero_smul := zero_mul
  one_smul := one_mul
  mul_smul := mul_assoc₃
  add_smul := Ring₃.right_distrib
  smul_add := Ring₃.left_distrib

def nsmul₁ [Zero M] [Add M] : ℕ → M → M
  | 0, _ => 0
  | n + 1, a => a + nsmul₁ n a

def zsmul₁ {M : Type*} [Zero M] [Add M] [Neg M] : ℤ → M → M
  | Int.ofNat n, a => nsmul₁ n a
  | Int.negSucc n, a => -nsmul₁ n.succ a

instance abGrpModule (A : Type) [AddCommGroup₃ A] : Module₁ ℤ A where
  smul := zsmul₁
  zero_smul := sorry
  one_smul := sorry
  mul_smul := sorry
  add_smul := sorry
  smul_add := sorry

class AddMonoid₄ (M : Type) extends AddSemigroup₃ M, AddZeroClass M where
  /-- Multiplication by a natural number. -/
  nsmul : ℕ → M → M := nsmul₁
  /-- Multiplication by `(0 : ℕ)` gives `0`. -/
  nsmul_zero : ∀ x, nsmul 0 x = 0 := by intros; rfl
  /-- Multiplication by `(n + 1 : ℕ)` behaves as expected. -/
  nsmul_succ : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x), nsmul (n + 1) x = x + nsmul n x := by intros; rfl

    intro a b
    have : a + (a + b + b) = a + (b + a + b) := calc
      a + (a + b + b) = (a + a) + (b + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃, add_assoc₃]

      _ = 1 * (a + b) + 1 * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (a + b) + (a + b) := by simp
      _ = a + (b + a + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃]

instance {R : Type} [Ring₃ R] : AddCommGroup₃ R :=
{ Ring₃.toAddGroup₃ with
  add_comm := by
    intro a b
    have : a + (a + b + b) = a + (b + a + b) := calc
      a + (a + b + b) = (a + a) + (b + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃, add_assoc₃]
      _ = (1 * a + 1 * a) + (1 * b + 1 * b) := by simp
      _ = (1 + 1) * a + (1 + 1) * b := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (1 + 1) * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.left_distrib]
      _ = 1 * (a + b) + 1 * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (a + b) + (a + b) := by simp
      _ = a + (b + a + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃]
    exact add_right_cancel₃ (add_left_cancel₃ this) }

class Ring₃ (R : Type) extends AddGroup₃ R, Monoid₃ R, MulZeroClass R where
  /-- Multiplication is left distributive over addition -/
  left_distrib : ∀ a b c : R, a * (b + c) = a * b + a * c
  /-- Multiplication is right distributive over addition -/
  right_distrib : ∀ a b c : R, (a + b) * c = a * c + b * c

instance {R : Type} [Ring₃ R] : AddCommGroup₃ R :=
{ Ring₃.toAddGroup₃ with
  add_comm := by
    intro a b
    have : a + (a + b + b) = a + (b + a + b) := calc
      a + (a + b + b) = (a + a) + (b + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃, add_assoc₃]
      _ = (1 * a + 1 * a) + (1 * b + 1 * b) := by simp
      _ = (1 + 1) * a + (1 + 1) * b := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (1 + 1) * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.left_distrib]
      _ = 1 * (a + b) + 1 * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (a + b) + (a + b) := by simp
      _ = a + (b + a + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃]
    exact add_right_cancel₃ (add_left_cancel₃ this) }

  add_smul := Ring₃.right_distrib

  | Int.negSucc n, a => -nsmul₁ n.succ a

  nsmul_succ : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x), nsmul (n + 1) x = x + nsmul n x := by intros; rfl

  one_smul : ∀ m : M, (1 : R) • m = m
  mul_smul : ∀ (a b : R) (m : M), (a * b) • m = a • b • m
  add_smul : ∀ (a b : R) (m : M), (a + b) • m = a • m + b • m
  smul_add : ∀ (a : R) (m n : M), a • (m + n) = a • m + a • n

instance selfModule (R : Type) [Ring₃ R] : Module₁ R R where
  smul := fun r s ↦ r*s

  one_smul := one_mul

  add_smul := Ring₃.right_distrib
  smul_add := Ring₃.left_distrib

def nsmul₁ [Zero M] [Add M] : ℕ → M → M

  | n + 1, a => a + nsmul₁ n a

  | Int.negSucc n, a => -nsmul₁ n.succ a

  smul := zsmul₁

  one_smul := sorry
  mul_smul := sorry

  /-- Multiplication is right distributive over addition -/
  right_distrib : ∀ a b c : R, (a + b) * c = a * c + b * c

instance {R : Type} [Ring₃ R] : AddCommGroup₃ R :=
{ Ring₃.toAddGroup₃ with
  add_comm := by
    intro a b
    have : a + (a + b + b) = a + (b + a + b) := calc
      a + (a + b + b) = (a + a) + (b + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃, add_assoc₃]
      _ = (1 * a + 1 * a) + (1 * b + 1 * b) := by simp

      _ = (1 + 1) * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.left_distrib]
      _ = 1 * (a + b) + 1 * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (a + b) + (a + b) := by simp
      _ = a + (b + a + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃]
    exact add_right_cancel₃ (add_left_cancel₃ this) }

  /-- Multiplication is left distributive over addition -/
  left_distrib : ∀ a b c : R, a * (b + c) = a * b + a * c
  /-- Multiplication is right distributive over addition -/
  right_distrib : ∀ a b c : R, (a + b) * c = a * c + b * c

instance {R : Type} [Ring₃ R] : AddCommGroup₃ R :=
{ Ring₃.toAddGroup₃ with
  add_comm := by
    intro a b
    have : a + (a + b + b) = a + (b + a + b) := calc
      a + (a + b + b) = (a + a) + (b + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃, add_assoc₃]
      _ = (1 * a + 1 * a) + (1 * b + 1 * b) := by simp
      _ = (1 + 1) * a + (1 + 1) * b := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (1 + 1) * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.left_distrib]
      _ = 1 * (a + b) + 1 * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (a + b) + (a + b) := by simp
      _ = a + (b + a + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃]
    exact add_right_cancel₃ (add_left_cancel₃ this) }

instance {R : Type} [Ring₃ R] : AddCommGroup₃ R :=
{ Ring₃.toAddGroup₃ with
  add_comm := by
    intro a b
    have : a + (a + b + b) = a + (b + a + b) := calc
      a + (a + b + b) = (a + a) + (b + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃, add_assoc₃]
      _ = (1 * a + 1 * a) + (1 * b + 1 * b) := by simp
      _ = (1 + 1) * a + (1 + 1) * b := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (1 + 1) * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.left_distrib]
      _ = 1 * (a + b) + 1 * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (a + b) + (a + b) := by simp
      _ = a + (b + a + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃]
    exact add_right_cancel₃ (add_left_cancel₃ this) }

  /-- Multiplication by a natural number. -/
  nsmul : ℕ → M → M := nsmul₁
  /-- Multiplication by `(0 : ℕ)` gives `0`. -/
  nsmul_zero : ∀ x, nsmul 0 x = 0 := by intros; rfl
  /-- Multiplication by `(n + 1 : ℕ)` behaves as expected. -/

{ Ring₃.toAddGroup₃ with
  add_comm := by
    intro a b
    have : a + (a + b + b) = a + (b + a + b) := calc
      a + (a + b + b) = (a + a) + (b + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃, add_assoc₃]
      _ = (1 * a + 1 * a) + (1 * b + 1 * b) := by simp
      _ = (1 + 1) * a + (1 + 1) * b := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (1 + 1) * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.left_distrib]
      _ = 1 * (a + b) + 1 * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (a + b) + (a + b) := by simp
      _ = a + (b + a + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃]
    exact add_right_cancel₃ (add_left_cancel₃ this) }

      _ = 1 * (a + b) + 1 * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (a + b) + (a + b) := by simp
      _ = a + (b + a + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃]

  add_comm := by
    intro a b
    have : a + (a + b + b) = a + (b + a + b) := calc
      a + (a + b + b) = (a + a) + (b + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃, add_assoc₃]
      _ = (1 * a + 1 * a) + (1 * b + 1 * b) := by simp
      _ = (1 + 1) * a + (1 + 1) * b := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (1 + 1) * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.left_distrib]
      _ = 1 * (a + b) + 1 * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (a + b) + (a + b) := by simp
      _ = a + (b + a + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃]
    exact add_right_cancel₃ (add_left_cancel₃ this) }

  /-- Multiplication is left distributive over addition -/

  /-- Multiplication is right distributive over addition -/
  right_distrib : ∀ a b c : R, (a + b) * c = a * c + b * c

instance {R : Type} [Ring₃ R] : AddCommGroup₃ R :=
{ Ring₃.toAddGroup₃ with
  add_comm := by
    intro a b
    have : a + (a + b + b) = a + (b + a + b) := calc
      a + (a + b + b) = (a + a) + (b + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃, add_assoc₃]
      _ = (1 * a + 1 * a) + (1 * b + 1 * b) := by simp
      _ = (1 + 1) * a + (1 + 1) * b := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (1 + 1) * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.left_distrib]
      _ = 1 * (a + b) + 1 * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (a + b) + (a + b) := by simp
      _ = a + (b + a + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃]
    exact add_right_cancel₃ (add_left_cancel₃ this) }

class Ring₃ (R : Type) extends AddGroup₃ R, Monoid₃ R, MulZeroClass R where
  /-- Multiplication is left distributive over addition -/
  left_distrib : ∀ a b c : R, a * (b + c) = a * b + a * c
  /-- Multiplication is right distributive over addition -/
  right_distrib : ∀ a b c : R, (a + b) * c = a * c + b * c

instance {R : Type} [Ring₃ R] : AddCommGroup₃ R :=
{ Ring₃.toAddGroup₃ with
  add_comm := by
    intro a b
    have : a + (a + b + b) = a + (b + a + b) := calc
      a + (a + b + b) = (a + a) + (b + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃, add_assoc₃]
      _ = (1 * a + 1 * a) + (1 * b + 1 * b) := by simp
      _ = (1 + 1) * a + (1 + 1) * b := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (1 + 1) * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.left_distrib]
      _ = 1 * (a + b) + 1 * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (a + b) + (a + b) := by simp
      _ = a + (b + a + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃]
    exact add_right_cancel₃ (add_left_cancel₃ this) }

  zero_smul : ∀ m : M, (0 : R) • m = 0
  one_smul : ∀ m : M, (1 : R) • m = m

  add_smul : ∀ (a b : R) (m : M), (a + b) • m = a • m + b • m

  smul := fun r s ↦ r*s

  one_smul := one_mul
  mul_smul := mul_assoc₃
  add_smul := Ring₃.right_distrib
  smul_add := Ring₃.left_distrib

def nsmul₁ [Zero M] [Add M] : ℕ → M → M
  | 0, _ => 0
  | n + 1, a => a + nsmul₁ n a

def zsmul₁ {M : Type*} [Zero M] [Add M] [Neg M] : ℤ → M → M
  | Int.ofNat n, a => nsmul₁ n a
  | Int.negSucc n, a => -nsmul₁ n.succ a

class Ring₃ (R : Type) extends AddGroup₃ R, Monoid₃ R, MulZeroClass R where
  /-- Multiplication is left distributive over addition -/
  left_distrib : ∀ a b c : R, a * (b + c) = a * b + a * c
  /-- Multiplication is right distributive over addition -/
  right_distrib : ∀ a b c : R, (a + b) * c = a * c + b * c

instance {R : Type} [Ring₃ R] : AddCommGroup₃ R :=
{ Ring₃.toAddGroup₃ with
  add_comm := by
    intro a b
    have : a + (a + b + b) = a + (b + a + b) := calc
      a + (a + b + b) = (a + a) + (b + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃, add_assoc₃]
      _ = (1 * a + 1 * a) + (1 * b + 1 * b) := by simp
      _ = (1 + 1) * a + (1 + 1) * b := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (1 + 1) * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.left_distrib]
      _ = 1 * (a + b) + 1 * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (a + b) + (a + b) := by simp
      _ = a + (b + a + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃]
    exact add_right_cancel₃ (add_left_cancel₃ this) }

class Module₁ (R : Type) [Ring₃ R] (M : Type) [AddCommGroup₃ M] extends SMul₃ R M where
  zero_smul : ∀ m : M, (0 : R) • m = 0
  one_smul : ∀ m : M, (1 : R) • m = m
  mul_smul : ∀ (a b : R) (m : M), (a * b) • m = a • b • m
  add_smul : ∀ (a b : R) (m : M), (a + b) • m = a • m + b • m
  smul_add : ∀ (a : R) (m n : M), a • (m + n) = a • m + a • n

instance selfModule (R : Type) [Ring₃ R] : Module₁ R R where
  smul := fun r s ↦ r*s
  zero_smul := zero_mul
  one_smul := one_mul
  mul_smul := mul_assoc₃
  add_smul := Ring₃.right_distrib
  smul_add := Ring₃.left_distrib

  | 0, _ => 0
  | n + 1, a => a + nsmul₁ n a

  | Int.ofNat n, a => nsmul₁ n a

      a + (a + b + b) = (a + a) + (b + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃, add_assoc₃]
      _ = (1 * a + 1 * a) + (1 * b + 1 * b) := by simp
      _ = (1 + 1) * a + (1 + 1) * b := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]

  right_distrib : ∀ a b c : R, (a + b) * c = a * c + b * c

instance {R : Type} [Ring₃ R] : AddCommGroup₃ R :=
{ Ring₃.toAddGroup₃ with
  add_comm := by
    intro a b
    have : a + (a + b + b) = a + (b + a + b) := calc
      a + (a + b + b) = (a + a) + (b + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃, add_assoc₃]
      _ = (1 * a + 1 * a) + (1 * b + 1 * b) := by simp
      _ = (1 + 1) * a + (1 + 1) * b := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (1 + 1) * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.left_distrib]
      _ = 1 * (a + b) + 1 * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (a + b) + (a + b) := by simp
      _ = a + (b + a + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃]
    exact add_right_cancel₃ (add_left_cancel₃ this) }

  /-- Multiplication is right distributive over addition -/
  right_distrib : ∀ a b c : R, (a + b) * c = a * c + b * c

instance {R : Type} [Ring₃ R] : AddCommGroup₃ R :=
{ Ring₃.toAddGroup₃ with
  add_comm := by
    intro a b
    have : a + (a + b + b) = a + (b + a + b) := calc
      a + (a + b + b) = (a + a) + (b + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃, add_assoc₃]
      _ = (1 * a + 1 * a) + (1 * b + 1 * b) := by simp
      _ = (1 + 1) * a + (1 + 1) * b := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (1 + 1) * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.left_distrib]
      _ = 1 * (a + b) + 1 * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (a + b) + (a + b) := by simp
      _ = a + (b + a + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃]
    exact add_right_cancel₃ (add_left_cancel₃ this) }

  /-- Multiplication is left distributive over addition -/

  /-- Multiplication is right distributive over addition -/
  right_distrib : ∀ a b c : R, (a + b) * c = a * c + b * c

instance {R : Type} [Ring₃ R] : AddCommGroup₃ R :=
{ Ring₃.toAddGroup₃ with
  add_comm := by
    intro a b
    have : a + (a + b + b) = a + (b + a + b) := calc
      a + (a + b + b) = (a + a) + (b + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃, add_assoc₃]
      _ = (1 * a + 1 * a) + (1 * b + 1 * b) := by simp
      _ = (1 + 1) * a + (1 + 1) * b := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (1 + 1) * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.left_distrib]
      _ = 1 * (a + b) + 1 * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (a + b) + (a + b) := by simp
      _ = a + (b + a + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃]
    exact add_right_cancel₃ (add_left_cancel₃ this) }

  /-- Multiplication is left distributive over addition -/
  left_distrib : ∀ a b c : R, a * (b + c) = a * b + a * c
  /-- Multiplication is right distributive over addition -/
  right_distrib : ∀ a b c : R, (a + b) * c = a * c + b * c

instance {R : Type} [Ring₃ R] : AddCommGroup₃ R :=
{ Ring₃.toAddGroup₃ with
  add_comm := by
    intro a b
    have : a + (a + b + b) = a + (b + a + b) := calc
      a + (a + b + b) = (a + a) + (b + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃, add_assoc₃]
      _ = (1 * a + 1 * a) + (1 * b + 1 * b) := by simp
      _ = (1 + 1) * a + (1 + 1) * b := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (1 + 1) * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.left_distrib]
      _ = 1 * (a + b) + 1 * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (a + b) + (a + b) := by simp
      _ = a + (b + a + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃]
    exact add_right_cancel₃ (add_left_cancel₃ this) }

class Ring₃ (R : Type) extends AddGroup₃ R, Monoid₃ R, MulZeroClass R where
  /-- Multiplication is left distributive over addition -/
  left_distrib : ∀ a b c : R, a * (b + c) = a * b + a * c
  /-- Multiplication is right distributive over addition -/
  right_distrib : ∀ a b c : R, (a + b) * c = a * c + b * c

instance {R : Type} [Ring₃ R] : AddCommGroup₃ R :=
{ Ring₃.toAddGroup₃ with
  add_comm := by
    intro a b
    have : a + (a + b + b) = a + (b + a + b) := calc
      a + (a + b + b) = (a + a) + (b + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃, add_assoc₃]
      _ = (1 * a + 1 * a) + (1 * b + 1 * b) := by simp
      _ = (1 + 1) * a + (1 + 1) * b := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (1 + 1) * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.left_distrib]
      _ = 1 * (a + b) + 1 * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (a + b) + (a + b) := by simp
      _ = a + (b + a + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃]
    exact add_right_cancel₃ (add_left_cancel₃ this) }

  add_comm := by
    intro a b
    have : a + (a + b + b) = a + (b + a + b) := calc
      a + (a + b + b) = (a + a) + (b + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃, add_assoc₃]
      _ = (1 * a + 1 * a) + (1 * b + 1 * b) := by simp
      _ = (1 + 1) * a + (1 + 1) * b := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (1 + 1) * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.left_distrib]
      _ = 1 * (a + b) + 1 * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (a + b) + (a + b) := by simp
      _ = a + (b + a + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃]
    exact add_right_cancel₃ (add_left_cancel₃ this) }

instance {R : Type} [Ring₃ R] : AddCommGroup₃ R :=
{ Ring₃.toAddGroup₃ with
  add_comm := by
    intro a b
    have : a + (a + b + b) = a + (b + a + b) := calc
      a + (a + b + b) = (a + a) + (b + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃, add_assoc₃]
      _ = (1 * a + 1 * a) + (1 * b + 1 * b) := by simp
      _ = (1 + 1) * a + (1 + 1) * b := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (1 + 1) * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.left_distrib]
      _ = 1 * (a + b) + 1 * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (a + b) + (a + b) := by simp
      _ = a + (b + a + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃]
    exact add_right_cancel₃ (add_left_cancel₃ this) }

class Ring₃ (R : Type) extends AddGroup₃ R, Monoid₃ R, MulZeroClass R where
  /-- Multiplication is left distributive over addition -/
  left_distrib : ∀ a b c : R, a * (b + c) = a * b + a * c
  /-- Multiplication is right distributive over addition -/
  right_distrib : ∀ a b c : R, (a + b) * c = a * c + b * c

instance {R : Type} [Ring₃ R] : AddCommGroup₃ R :=
{ Ring₃.toAddGroup₃ with
  add_comm := by
    intro a b
    have : a + (a + b + b) = a + (b + a + b) := calc
      a + (a + b + b) = (a + a) + (b + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃, add_assoc₃]
      _ = (1 * a + 1 * a) + (1 * b + 1 * b) := by simp
      _ = (1 + 1) * a + (1 + 1) * b := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (1 + 1) * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.left_distrib]
      _ = 1 * (a + b) + 1 * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (a + b) + (a + b) := by simp
      _ = a + (b + a + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃]
    exact add_right_cancel₃ (add_left_cancel₃ this) }

class Ring₃ (R : Type) extends AddGroup₃ R, Monoid₃ R, MulZeroClass R where
  /-- Multiplication is left distributive over addition -/
  left_distrib : ∀ a b c : R, a * (b + c) = a * b + a * c
  /-- Multiplication is right distributive over addition -/
  right_distrib : ∀ a b c : R, (a + b) * c = a * c + b * c

instance {R : Type} [Ring₃ R] : AddCommGroup₃ R :=
{ Ring₃.toAddGroup₃ with
  add_comm := by
    intro a b
    have : a + (a + b + b) = a + (b + a + b) := calc
      a + (a + b + b) = (a + a) + (b + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃, add_assoc₃]
      _ = (1 * a + 1 * a) + (1 * b + 1 * b) := by simp
      _ = (1 + 1) * a + (1 + 1) * b := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (1 + 1) * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.left_distrib]
      _ = 1 * (a + b) + 1 * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (a + b) + (a + b) := by simp
      _ = a + (b + a + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃]
    exact add_right_cancel₃ (add_left_cancel₃ this) }

class Ring₃ (R : Type) extends AddGroup₃ R, Monoid₃ R, MulZeroClass R where
  /-- Multiplication is left distributive over addition -/
  left_distrib : ∀ a b c : R, a * (b + c) = a * b + a * c
  /-- Multiplication is right distributive over addition -/
  right_distrib : ∀ a b c : R, (a + b) * c = a * c + b * c

instance {R : Type} [Ring₃ R] : AddCommGroup₃ R :=
{ Ring₃.toAddGroup₃ with
  add_comm := by
    intro a b
    have : a + (a + b + b) = a + (b + a + b) := calc
      a + (a + b + b) = (a + a) + (b + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃, add_assoc₃]
      _ = (1 * a + 1 * a) + (1 * b + 1 * b) := by simp
      _ = (1 + 1) * a + (1 + 1) * b := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (1 + 1) * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.left_distrib]
      _ = 1 * (a + b) + 1 * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (a + b) + (a + b) := by simp
      _ = a + (b + a + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃]
    exact add_right_cancel₃ (add_left_cancel₃ this) }

  /-- Multiplication is left distributive over addition -/

  /-- Multiplication is right distributive over addition -/
  right_distrib : ∀ a b c : R, (a + b) * c = a * c + b * c

instance {R : Type} [Ring₃ R] : AddCommGroup₃ R :=
{ Ring₃.toAddGroup₃ with
  add_comm := by
    intro a b
    have : a + (a + b + b) = a + (b + a + b) := calc
      a + (a + b + b) = (a + a) + (b + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃, add_assoc₃]
      _ = (1 * a + 1 * a) + (1 * b + 1 * b) := by simp
      _ = (1 + 1) * a + (1 + 1) * b := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (1 + 1) * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.left_distrib]
      _ = 1 * (a + b) + 1 * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (a + b) + (a + b) := by simp
      _ = a + (b + a + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃]
    exact add_right_cancel₃ (add_left_cancel₃ this) }

      a + (a + b + b) = (a + a) + (b + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃, add_assoc₃]
      _ = (1 * a + 1 * a) + (1 * b + 1 * b) := by simp
      _ = (1 + 1) * a + (1 + 1) * b := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]

      _ = 1 * (a + b) + 1 * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (a + b) + (a + b) := by simp
      _ = a + (b + a + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃]

class Ring₃ (R : Type) extends AddGroup₃ R, Monoid₃ R, MulZeroClass R where
  /-- Multiplication is left distributive over addition -/
  left_distrib : ∀ a b c : R, a * (b + c) = a * b + a * c
  /-- Multiplication is right distributive over addition -/
  right_distrib : ∀ a b c : R, (a + b) * c = a * c + b * c

instance {R : Type} [Ring₃ R] : AddCommGroup₃ R :=
{ Ring₃.toAddGroup₃ with
  add_comm := by
    intro a b
    have : a + (a + b + b) = a + (b + a + b) := calc
      a + (a + b + b) = (a + a) + (b + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃, add_assoc₃]
      _ = (1 * a + 1 * a) + (1 * b + 1 * b) := by simp
      _ = (1 + 1) * a + (1 + 1) * b := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (1 + 1) * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.left_distrib]
      _ = 1 * (a + b) + 1 * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (a + b) + (a + b) := by simp
      _ = a + (b + a + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃]
    exact add_right_cancel₃ (add_left_cancel₃ this) }

  /-- The element one -/
  one : α

#check One₂.one

class Dia₁ (α : Type) where
  dia : α → α → α

infixl:70 " ⋄ "   => Dia₁.dia


class Semigroup₁ (α : Type) where
  toDia₁ : Dia₁ α
  /-- Diamond is associative -/
  dia_assoc : ∀ a b c : α, a ⋄ b ⋄ c = a ⋄ (b ⋄ c)


attribute [instance] Semigroup₁.toDia₁

-- theorem C07_S01_4{α : Type} [Semigroup₁ α] (a b : α) : α := a ⋄ b


class Semigroup₂ (α : Type) extends Dia₁ α where
  /-- Diamond is associative -/
  dia_assoc : ∀ a b c : α, a ⋄ b ⋄ c = a ⋄ (b ⋄ c)

-- theorem C07_S01_5{α : Type} [Semigroup₂ α] (a b : α) : α := a ⋄ b

class DiaOneClass₁ (α : Type) extends One₁ α, Dia₁ α where
  /-- One is a left neutral element for diamond. -/
  one_dia : ∀ a : α, 𝟙 ⋄ a = a
  /-- One is a right neutral element for diamond -/
  dia_one : ∀ a : α, a ⋄ 𝟙 = a



set_option trace.Meta.synthInstance true in

  toSemigroup₁ : Semigroup₁ α
  toDiaOneClass₁ : DiaOneClass₁ α


theorem C07_S01_7{α : Type} [Monoid₁ α] :
  (Monoid₁.toSemigroup₁.toDia₁.dia : α → α → α) = Monoid₁.toDiaOneClass₁.toDia₁.dia := rfl

class Inv₁ (α : Type) where
  /-- The inversion function -/
  inv : α → α

@[inherit_doc]
postfix:max "⁻¹" => Inv₁.inv

class Group₁ (G : Type) extends Monoid₁ G, Inv₁ G where
  inv_dia : ∀ a : G, a⁻¹ ⋄ a = 𝟙


lemma left_inv_eq_right_inv₁ {M : Type} [Monoid₁ M] {a b c : M} (hba : b ⋄ a = 𝟙) (hac : a ⋄ c = 𝟙) : b = c := by
  rw [← DiaOneClass₁.one_dia c, ← hba, Semigroup₁.dia_assoc, hac, DiaOneClass₁.dia_one b]


export DiaOneClass₁ (one_dia dia_one)
export Semigroup₁ (dia_assoc)
export Group₁ (inv_dia)


theorem C07_S01_8{M : Type} [Monoid₁ M] {a b c : M} (hba : b ⋄ a = 𝟙) (hac : a ⋄ c = 𝟙) : b = c := by
  rw [← one_dia c, ← hba, dia_assoc, hac, dia_one b]


lemma inv_eq_of_dia [Group₁ G] {a b : G} (h : a ⋄ b = 𝟙) : a⁻¹ = b :=
  left_inv_eq_right_inv₁ (inv_dia a) h

lemma dia_inv [Group₁ G] (a : G) : a ⋄ a⁻¹ = 𝟙 :=
  by rw [← inv_dia a⁻¹, inv_eq_of_dia (inv_dia a)]

/-- Multiplication is associative -/
  mul_assoc₃ : ∀ a b c : α, a * b * c = a * (b * c)

lemma inv_eq_of_mul [Group₃ G] {a b : G} (h : a * b = 1) : a⁻¹ = b :=

lemma mul_left_cancel₃ {G : Type} [Group₃ G] {a b c : G} (h : a * b = a * c) : b = c := by

  simpa [mul_assoc₃] using congr_arg (· * a⁻¹) h

class Ring₃ (R : Type) extends AddGroup₃ R, Monoid₃ R, MulZeroClass R where
  /-- Multiplication is left distributive over addition -/
  left_distrib : ∀ a b c : R, a * (b + c) = a * b + a * c
  /-- Multiplication is right distributive over addition -/
  right_distrib : ∀ a b c : R, (a + b) * c = a * c + b * c

instance {R : Type} [Ring₃ R] : AddCommGroup₃ R :=
{ Ring₃.toAddGroup₃ with
  add_comm := by
    intro a b
    have : a + (a + b + b) = a + (b + a + b) := calc
      a + (a + b + b) = (a + a) + (b + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃, add_assoc₃]
      _ = (1 * a + 1 * a) + (1 * b + 1 * b) := by simp
      _ = (1 + 1) * a + (1 + 1) * b := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (1 + 1) * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.left_distrib]
      _ = 1 * (a + b) + 1 * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (a + b) + (a + b) := by simp
      _ = a + (b + a + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃]
    exact add_right_cancel₃ (add_left_cancel₃ this) }

      a + (a + b + b) = (a + a) + (b + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃, add_assoc₃]

class Ring₃ (R : Type) extends AddGroup₃ R, Monoid₃ R, MulZeroClass R where
  /-- Multiplication is left distributive over addition -/
  left_distrib : ∀ a b c : R, a * (b + c) = a * b + a * c
  /-- Multiplication is right distributive over addition -/
  right_distrib : ∀ a b c : R, (a + b) * c = a * c + b * c

instance {R : Type} [Ring₃ R] : AddCommGroup₃ R :=
{ Ring₃.toAddGroup₃ with
  add_comm := by
    intro a b
    have : a + (a + b + b) = a + (b + a + b) := calc
      a + (a + b + b) = (a + a) + (b + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃, add_assoc₃]
      _ = (1 * a + 1 * a) + (1 * b + 1 * b) := by simp
      _ = (1 + 1) * a + (1 + 1) * b := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (1 + 1) * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.left_distrib]
      _ = 1 * (a + b) + 1 * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (a + b) + (a + b) := by simp
      _ = a + (b + a + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃]
    exact add_right_cancel₃ (add_left_cancel₃ this) }

class Ring₃ (R : Type) extends AddGroup₃ R, Monoid₃ R, MulZeroClass R where
  /-- Multiplication is left distributive over addition -/
  left_distrib : ∀ a b c : R, a * (b + c) = a * b + a * c
  /-- Multiplication is right distributive over addition -/
  right_distrib : ∀ a b c : R, (a + b) * c = a * c + b * c

instance {R : Type} [Ring₃ R] : AddCommGroup₃ R :=
{ Ring₃.toAddGroup₃ with
  add_comm := by
    intro a b
    have : a + (a + b + b) = a + (b + a + b) := calc
      a + (a + b + b) = (a + a) + (b + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃, add_assoc₃]
      _ = (1 * a + 1 * a) + (1 * b + 1 * b) := by simp
      _ = (1 + 1) * a + (1 + 1) * b := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (1 + 1) * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.left_distrib]

class Ring₃ (R : Type) extends AddGroup₃ R, Monoid₃ R, MulZeroClass R where
  /-- Multiplication is left distributive over addition -/
  left_distrib : ∀ a b c : R, a * (b + c) = a * b + a * c
  /-- Multiplication is right distributive over addition -/
  right_distrib : ∀ a b c : R, (a + b) * c = a * c + b * c

instance {R : Type} [Ring₃ R] : AddCommGroup₃ R :=
{ Ring₃.toAddGroup₃ with
  add_comm := by
    intro a b
    have : a + (a + b + b) = a + (b + a + b) := calc
      a + (a + b + b) = (a + a) + (b + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃, add_assoc₃]
      _ = (1 * a + 1 * a) + (1 * b + 1 * b) := by simp
      _ = (1 + 1) * a + (1 + 1) * b := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (1 + 1) * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.left_distrib]
      _ = 1 * (a + b) + 1 * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (a + b) + (a + b) := by simp
      _ = a + (b + a + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃]
    exact add_right_cancel₃ (add_left_cancel₃ this) }

class Ring₃ (R : Type) extends AddGroup₃ R, Monoid₃ R, MulZeroClass R where
  /-- Multiplication is left distributive over addition -/
  left_distrib : ∀ a b c : R, a * (b + c) = a * b + a * c
  /-- Multiplication is right distributive over addition -/
  right_distrib : ∀ a b c : R, (a + b) * c = a * c + b * c

instance {R : Type} [Ring₃ R] : AddCommGroup₃ R :=
{ Ring₃.toAddGroup₃ with
  add_comm := by
    intro a b
    have : a + (a + b + b) = a + (b + a + b) := calc
      a + (a + b + b) = (a + a) + (b + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃, add_assoc₃]
      _ = (1 * a + 1 * a) + (1 * b + 1 * b) := by simp
      _ = (1 + 1) * a + (1 + 1) * b := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (1 + 1) * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.left_distrib]
      _ = 1 * (a + b) + 1 * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (a + b) + (a + b) := by simp
      _ = a + (b + a + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃]
    exact add_right_cancel₃ (add_left_cancel₃ this) }

      _ = 1 * (a + b) + 1 * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (a + b) + (a + b) := by simp
      _ = a + (b + a + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃]

class Ring₃ (R : Type) extends AddGroup₃ R, Monoid₃ R, MulZeroClass R where
  /-- Multiplication is left distributive over addition -/
  left_distrib : ∀ a b c : R, a * (b + c) = a * b + a * c
  /-- Multiplication is right distributive over addition -/
  right_distrib : ∀ a b c : R, (a + b) * c = a * c + b * c

instance {R : Type} [Ring₃ R] : AddCommGroup₃ R :=
{ Ring₃.toAddGroup₃ with
  add_comm := by
    intro a b
    have : a + (a + b + b) = a + (b + a + b) := calc
      a + (a + b + b) = (a + a) + (b + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃, add_assoc₃]
      _ = (1 * a + 1 * a) + (1 * b + 1 * b) := by simp
      _ = (1 + 1) * a + (1 + 1) * b := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (1 + 1) * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.left_distrib]
      _ = 1 * (a + b) + 1 * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (a + b) + (a + b) := by simp
      _ = a + (b + a + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃]
    exact add_right_cancel₃ (add_left_cancel₃ this) }

      a + (a + b + b) = (a + a) + (b + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃, add_assoc₃]

{ Ring₃.toAddGroup₃ with
  add_comm := by
    intro a b
    have : a + (a + b + b) = a + (b + a + b) := calc
      a + (a + b + b) = (a + a) + (b + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃, add_assoc₃]
      _ = (1 * a + 1 * a) + (1 * b + 1 * b) := by simp

      _ = 1 * (a + b) + 1 * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]

    exact add_right_cancel₃ (add_left_cancel₃ this) }

class Ring₃ (R : Type) extends AddGroup₃ R, Monoid₃ R, MulZeroClass R where
  /-- Multiplication is left distributive over addition -/
  left_distrib : ∀ a b c : R, a * (b + c) = a * b + a * c
  /-- Multiplication is right distributive over addition -/
  right_distrib : ∀ a b c : R, (a + b) * c = a * c + b * c

instance {R : Type} [Ring₃ R] : AddCommGroup₃ R :=
{ Ring₃.toAddGroup₃ with
  add_comm := by
    intro a b
    have : a + (a + b + b) = a + (b + a + b) := calc
      a + (a + b + b) = (a + a) + (b + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃, add_assoc₃]
      _ = (1 * a + 1 * a) + (1 * b + 1 * b) := by simp
      _ = (1 + 1) * a + (1 + 1) * b := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (1 + 1) * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.left_distrib]
      _ = 1 * (a + b) + 1 * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (a + b) + (a + b) := by simp
      _ = a + (b + a + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃]
    exact add_right_cancel₃ (add_left_cancel₃ this) }

      a + (a + b + b) = (a + a) + (b + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃, add_assoc₃]
      _ = (1 * a + 1 * a) + (1 * b + 1 * b) := by simp
      _ = (1 + 1) * a + (1 + 1) * b := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]

      _ = 1 * (a + b) + 1 * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (a + b) + (a + b) := by simp
      _ = a + (b + a + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃]

class Ring₃ (R : Type) extends AddGroup₃ R, Monoid₃ R, MulZeroClass R where
  /-- Multiplication is left distributive over addition -/
  left_distrib : ∀ a b c : R, a * (b + c) = a * b + a * c
  /-- Multiplication is right distributive over addition -/
  right_distrib : ∀ a b c : R, (a + b) * c = a * c + b * c

instance {R : Type} [Ring₃ R] : AddCommGroup₃ R :=
{ Ring₃.toAddGroup₃ with
  add_comm := by
    intro a b
    have : a + (a + b + b) = a + (b + a + b) := calc
      a + (a + b + b) = (a + a) + (b + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃, add_assoc₃]
      _ = (1 * a + 1 * a) + (1 * b + 1 * b) := by simp
      _ = (1 + 1) * a + (1 + 1) * b := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (1 + 1) * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.left_distrib]
      _ = 1 * (a + b) + 1 * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (a + b) + (a + b) := by simp
      _ = a + (b + a + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃]
    exact add_right_cancel₃ (add_left_cancel₃ this) }

  /-- Multiplication is left distributive over addition -/

  /-- Multiplication is right distributive over addition -/
  right_distrib : ∀ a b c : R, (a + b) * c = a * c + b * c

instance {R : Type} [Ring₃ R] : AddCommGroup₃ R :=
{ Ring₃.toAddGroup₃ with
  add_comm := by
    intro a b
    have : a + (a + b + b) = a + (b + a + b) := calc
      a + (a + b + b) = (a + a) + (b + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃, add_assoc₃]
      _ = (1 * a + 1 * a) + (1 * b + 1 * b) := by simp
      _ = (1 + 1) * a + (1 + 1) * b := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (1 + 1) * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.left_distrib]
      _ = 1 * (a + b) + 1 * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (a + b) + (a + b) := by simp
      _ = a + (b + a + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃]
    exact add_right_cancel₃ (add_left_cancel₃ this) }

lemma mul_left_cancel₃ {G : Type} [Group₃ G] {a b c : G} (h : a * b = a * c) : b = c := by

  simpa [mul_assoc₃] using congr_arg (· * a⁻¹) h

class Ring₃ (R : Type) extends AddGroup₃ R, Monoid₃ R, MulZeroClass R where
  /-- Multiplication is left distributive over addition -/
  left_distrib : ∀ a b c : R, a * (b + c) = a * b + a * c
  /-- Multiplication is right distributive over addition -/
  right_distrib : ∀ a b c : R, (a + b) * c = a * c + b * c

instance {R : Type} [Ring₃ R] : AddCommGroup₃ R :=
{ Ring₃.toAddGroup₃ with
  add_comm := by
    intro a b
    have : a + (a + b + b) = a + (b + a + b) := calc
      a + (a + b + b) = (a + a) + (b + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃, add_assoc₃]
      _ = (1 * a + 1 * a) + (1 * b + 1 * b) := by simp
      _ = (1 + 1) * a + (1 + 1) * b := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (1 + 1) * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.left_distrib]
      _ = 1 * (a + b) + 1 * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (a + b) + (a + b) := by simp
      _ = a + (b + a + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃]
    exact add_right_cancel₃ (add_left_cancel₃ this) }

{ Ring₃.toAddGroup₃ with
  add_comm := by
    intro a b
    have : a + (a + b + b) = a + (b + a + b) := calc
      a + (a + b + b) = (a + a) + (b + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃, add_assoc₃]
      _ = (1 * a + 1 * a) + (1 * b + 1 * b) := by simp

      _ = (1 + 1) * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.left_distrib]
      _ = 1 * (a + b) + 1 * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (a + b) + (a + b) := by simp

class Ring₃ (R : Type) extends AddGroup₃ R, Monoid₃ R, MulZeroClass R where
  /-- Multiplication is left distributive over addition -/
  left_distrib : ∀ a b c : R, a * (b + c) = a * b + a * c
  /-- Multiplication is right distributive over addition -/
  right_distrib : ∀ a b c : R, (a + b) * c = a * c + b * c

instance {R : Type} [Ring₃ R] : AddCommGroup₃ R :=
{ Ring₃.toAddGroup₃ with
  add_comm := by
    intro a b
    have : a + (a + b + b) = a + (b + a + b) := calc
      a + (a + b + b) = (a + a) + (b + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃, add_assoc₃]
      _ = (1 * a + 1 * a) + (1 * b + 1 * b) := by simp
      _ = (1 + 1) * a + (1 + 1) * b := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (1 + 1) * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.left_distrib]
      _ = 1 * (a + b) + 1 * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (a + b) + (a + b) := by simp
      _ = a + (b + a + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃]
    exact add_right_cancel₃ (add_left_cancel₃ this) }

  /-- Multiplication is left distributive over addition -/

  /-- Multiplication is right distributive over addition -/
  right_distrib : ∀ a b c : R, (a + b) * c = a * c + b * c

instance {R : Type} [Ring₃ R] : AddCommGroup₃ R :=
{ Ring₃.toAddGroup₃ with
  add_comm := by
    intro a b
    have : a + (a + b + b) = a + (b + a + b) := calc
      a + (a + b + b) = (a + a) + (b + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃, add_assoc₃]
      _ = (1 * a + 1 * a) + (1 * b + 1 * b) := by simp
      _ = (1 + 1) * a + (1 + 1) * b := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (1 + 1) * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.left_distrib]
      _ = 1 * (a + b) + 1 * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (a + b) + (a + b) := by simp
      _ = a + (b + a + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃]
    exact add_right_cancel₃ (add_left_cancel₃ this) }

  /-- Multiplication is left distributive over addition -/
  left_distrib : ∀ a b c : R, a * (b + c) = a * b + a * c
  /-- Multiplication is right distributive over addition -/
  right_distrib : ∀ a b c : R, (a + b) * c = a * c + b * c

instance {R : Type} [Ring₃ R] : AddCommGroup₃ R :=
{ Ring₃.toAddGroup₃ with
  add_comm := by
    intro a b
    have : a + (a + b + b) = a + (b + a + b) := calc
      a + (a + b + b) = (a + a) + (b + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃, add_assoc₃]
      _ = (1 * a + 1 * a) + (1 * b + 1 * b) := by simp
      _ = (1 + 1) * a + (1 + 1) * b := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (1 + 1) * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.left_distrib]
      _ = 1 * (a + b) + 1 * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (a + b) + (a + b) := by simp
      _ = a + (b + a + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃]
    exact add_right_cancel₃ (add_left_cancel₃ this) }

      a + (a + b + b) = (a + a) + (b + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃, add_assoc₃]

      _ = (1 + 1) * a + (1 + 1) * b := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]

      _ = 1 * (a + b) + 1 * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]

instance {R : Type} [Ring₃ R] : AddCommGroup₃ R :=
{ Ring₃.toAddGroup₃ with
  add_comm := by
    intro a b
    have : a + (a + b + b) = a + (b + a + b) := calc
      a + (a + b + b) = (a + a) + (b + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃, add_assoc₃]
      _ = (1 * a + 1 * a) + (1 * b + 1 * b) := by simp
      _ = (1 + 1) * a + (1 + 1) * b := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (1 + 1) * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.left_distrib]
      _ = 1 * (a + b) + 1 * (a + b) := by simp [Ring₃.right_distrib]
      _ = (a + b) + (a + b) := by simp
      _ = a + (b + a + b) := by simp [add_assoc₃]
    exact add_right_cancel₃ (add_left_cancel₃ this) }

  dia_assoc : ∀ a b c : α, a ⋄ b ⋄ c = a ⋄ (b ⋄ c)

  /-- One is a left neutral element for diamond. -/
  one_dia : ∀ a : α, 𝟙 ⋄ a = a
  /-- One is a right neutral element for diamond -/
  dia_one : ∀ a : α, a ⋄ 𝟙 = a

  one : α

theorem C07_S01_3{α : Type} [One₁ α] : (𝟙 : α) = 𝟙 := rfl


class Dia₁ (α : Type) where
  dia : α → α → α

infixl:70 " ⋄ "   => Dia₁.dia


class Semigroup₁ (α : Type) where
  toDia₁ : Dia₁ α
  /-- Diamond is associative -/
  dia_assoc : ∀ a b c : α, a ⋄ b ⋄ c = a ⋄ (b ⋄ c)


attribute [instance] Semigroup₁.toDia₁

  /-- Diamond is associative -/
  dia_assoc : ∀ a b c : α, a ⋄ b ⋄ c = a ⋄ (b ⋄ c)

-- theorem C07_S01_5{α : Type} [Semigroup₂ α] (a b : α) : α := a ⋄ b

class DiaOneClass₁ (α : Type) extends One₁ α, Dia₁ α where
  /-- One is a left neutral element for diamond. -/
  one_dia : ∀ a : α, 𝟙 ⋄ a = a
  /-- One is a right neutral element for diamond -/
  dia_one : ∀ a : α, a ⋄ 𝟙 = a

  toDiaOneClass₁ : DiaOneClass₁ α


theorem C07_S01_7{α : Type} [Monoid₁ α] :

  inv_dia : ∀ a : G, a⁻¹ ⋄ a = 𝟙


lemma left_inv_eq_right_inv₁ {M : Type} [Monoid₁ M] {a b c : M} (hba : b ⋄ a = 𝟙) (hac : a ⋄ c = 𝟙) : b = c := by
  rw [← DiaOneClass₁.one_dia c, ← hba, Semigroup₁.dia_assoc, hac, DiaOneClass₁.dia_one b]

  one_dia : ∀ a : α, 𝟙 ⋄ a = a

import MIL.Common

import Mathlib.Data.Real.Basic

set_option autoImplicit true


class One₁ (α : Type) where
  /-- The element one -/
  one : α


#check One₁.one -- One₁.one {α : Type} [self : One₁ α] : α

@[class] structure One₂ (α : Type) where
  /-- The element one -/
  one : α

#check One₂.one


-- theorem C07_S01_0(α : Type) [One₁ α] : α := One₁.one

-- theorem C07_S01_1(α : Type) [One₁ α] := (One₁.one : α)

@[inherit_doc]
notation "𝟙" => One₁.one

-- theorem C07_S01_2{α : Type} [One₁ α] : α := 𝟙

theorem C07_S01_3{α : Type} [One₁ α] : (𝟙 : α) = 𝟙 := rfl


class Dia₁ (α : Type) where
  dia : α → α → α

infixl:70 " ⋄ "   => Dia₁.dia


class Semigroup₁ (α : Type) where
  toDia₁ : Dia₁ α
  /-- Diamond is associative -/
  dia_assoc : ∀ a b c : α, a ⋄ b ⋄ c = a ⋄ (b ⋄ c)


attribute [instance] Semigroup₁.toDia₁

-- theorem C07_S01_4{α : Type} [Semigroup₁ α] (a b : α) : α := a ⋄ b


class Semigroup₂ (α : Type) extends Dia₁ α where
  /-- Diamond is associative -/
  dia_assoc : ∀ a b c : α, a ⋄ b ⋄ c = a ⋄ (b ⋄ c)

-- theorem C07_S01_5{α : Type} [Semigroup₂ α] (a b : α) : α := a ⋄ b

class DiaOneClass₁ (α : Type) extends One₁ α, Dia₁ α where
  /-- One is a left neutral element for diamond. -/
  one_dia : ∀ a : α, 𝟙 ⋄ a = a
  /-- One is a right neutral element for diamond -/
  dia_one : ∀ a : α, a ⋄ 𝟙 = a



set_option trace.Meta.synthInstance true in
-- theorem C07_S01_6{α : Type} [DiaOneClass₁ α] (a b : α) : Prop := a ⋄ b = 𝟙


class Monoid₁ (α : Type) extends Semigroup₁ α, DiaOneClass₁ α


class Monoid₂ (α : Type) where
  toSemigroup₁ : Semigroup₁ α
  toDiaOneClass₁ : DiaOneClass₁ α


theorem C07_S01_7{α : Type} [Monoid₁ α] :
  (Monoid₁.toSemigroup₁.toDia₁.dia : α → α → α) = Monoid₁.toDiaOneClass₁.toDia₁.dia := rfl

#check Monoid₂.mk

#check Monoid₁.mk


#check Monoid₁.toSemigroup₁
#check Monoid₁.toDiaOneClass₁


class Inv₁ (α : Type) where
  /-- The inversion function -/
  inv : α → α

@[inherit_doc]
postfix:max "⁻¹" => Inv₁.inv

class Group₁ (G : Type) extends Monoid₁ G, Inv₁ G where
  inv_dia : ∀ a : G, a⁻¹ ⋄ a = 𝟙


lemma left_inv_eq_right_inv₁ {M : Type} [Monoid₁ M] {a b c : M} (hba : b ⋄ a = 𝟙) (hac : a ⋄ c = 𝟙) : b = c := by
  rw [← DiaOneClass₁.one_dia c, ← hba, Semigroup₁.dia_assoc, hac, DiaOneClass₁.dia_one b]


export DiaOneClass₁ (one_dia dia_one)
export Semigroup₁ (dia_assoc)
export Group₁ (inv_dia)


theorem C07_S01_8{M : Type} [Monoid₁ M] {a b c : M} (hba : b ⋄ a = 𝟙) (hac : a ⋄ c = 𝟙) : b = c := by
  rw [← one_dia c, ← hba, dia_assoc, hac, dia_one b]


lemma inv_eq_of_dia [Group₁ G] {a b : G} (h : a ⋄ b = 𝟙) : a⁻¹ = b :=

  one : α

  one_dia : ∀ a : α, 𝟙 ⋄ a = a

  one_dia : ∀ a : α, 𝟙 ⋄ a = a
  /-- One is a right neutral element for diamond -/
  dia_one : ∀ a : α, a ⋄ 𝟙 = a

theorem C07_S01_7{α : Type} [Monoid₁ α] :

lemma left_inv_eq_right_inv₁ {M : Type} [Monoid₁ M] {a b c : M} (hba : b ⋄ a = 𝟙) (hac : a ⋄ c = 𝟙) : b = c := by
  rw [← DiaOneClass₁.one_dia c, ← hba, Semigroup₁.dia_assoc, hac, DiaOneClass₁.dia_one b]


export DiaOneClass₁ (one_dia dia_one)

theorem C07_S01_8{M : Type} [Monoid₁ M] {a b c : M} (hba : b ⋄ a = 𝟙) (hac : a ⋄ c = 𝟙) : b = c := by
  rw [← one_dia c, ← hba, dia_assoc, hac, dia_one b]


lemma inv_eq_of_dia [Group₁ G] {a b : G} (h : a ⋄ b = 𝟙) : a⁻¹ = b :=

class DiaOneClass₁ (α : Type) extends One₁ α, Dia₁ α where
  /-- One is a left neutral element for diamond. -/
  one_dia : ∀ a : α, 𝟙 ⋄ a = a
  /-- One is a right neutral element for diamond -/
  dia_one : ∀ a : α, a ⋄ 𝟙 = a

  toDiaOneClass₁ : DiaOneClass₁ α


theorem C07_S01_7{α : Type} [Monoid₁ α] :

#check Monoid₁.mk

  inv : α → α

  inv_dia : ∀ a : G, a⁻¹ ⋄ a = 𝟙


lemma left_inv_eq_right_inv₁ {M : Type} [Monoid₁ M] {a b c : M} (hba : b ⋄ a = 𝟙) (hac : a ⋄ c = 𝟙) : b = c := by
  rw [← DiaOneClass₁.one_dia c, ← hba, Semigroup₁.dia_assoc, hac, DiaOneClass₁.dia_one b]


export DiaOneClass₁ (one_dia dia_one)

theorem C07_S01_8{M : Type} [Monoid₁ M] {a b c : M} (hba : b ⋄ a = 𝟙) (hac : a ⋄ c = 𝟙) : b = c := by
  rw [← one_dia c, ← hba, dia_assoc, hac, dia_one b]


lemma inv_eq_of_dia [Group₁ G] {a b : G} (h : a ⋄ b = 𝟙) : a⁻¹ = b :=
  left_inv_eq_right_inv₁ (inv_dia a) h

lemma dia_inv [Group₁ G] (a : G) : a ⋄ a⁻¹ = 𝟙 :=

  one_dia : ∀ a : α, 𝟙 ⋄ a = a
  /-- One is a right neutral element for diamond -/

lemma left_inv_eq_right_inv₁ {M : Type} [Monoid₁ M] {a b c : M} (hba : b ⋄ a = 𝟙) (hac : a ⋄ c = 𝟙) : b = c := by
  rw [← DiaOneClass₁.one_dia c, ← hba, Semigroup₁.dia_assoc, hac, DiaOneClass₁.dia_one b]

theorem C07_S01_8{M : Type} [Monoid₁ M] {a b c : M} (hba : b ⋄ a = 𝟙) (hac : a ⋄ c = 𝟙) : b = c := by

class DiaOneClass₁ (α : Type) extends One₁ α, Dia₁ α where
  /-- One is a left neutral element for diamond. -/
  one_dia : ∀ a : α, 𝟙 ⋄ a = a
  /-- One is a right neutral element for diamond -/
  dia_one : ∀ a : α, a ⋄ 𝟙 = a

  toDiaOneClass₁ : DiaOneClass₁ α


theorem C07_S01_7{α : Type} [Monoid₁ α] :
  (Monoid₁.toSemigroup₁.toDia₁.dia : α → α → α) = Monoid₁.toDiaOneClass₁.toDia₁.dia := rfl

  inv : α → α

  inv_dia : ∀ a : G, a⁻¹ ⋄ a = 𝟙


lemma left_inv_eq_right_inv₁ {M : Type} [Monoid₁ M] {a b c : M} (hba : b ⋄ a = 𝟙) (hac : a ⋄ c = 𝟙) : b = c := by
  rw [← DiaOneClass₁.one_dia c, ← hba, Semigroup₁.dia_assoc, hac, DiaOneClass₁.dia_one b]


export DiaOneClass₁ (one_dia dia_one)

theorem C07_S01_8{M : Type} [Monoid₁ M] {a b c : M} (hba : b ⋄ a = 𝟙) (hac : a ⋄ c = 𝟙) : b = c := by
  rw [← one_dia c, ← hba, dia_assoc, hac, dia_one b]


lemma inv_eq_of_dia [Group₁ G] {a b : G} (h : a ⋄ b = 𝟙) : a⁻¹ = b :=
  left_inv_eq_right_inv₁ (inv_dia a) h

import MIL.Common

  one : α

  /-- The element one -/
  one : α

#check One₂.one


-- theorem C07_S01_0(α : Type) [One₁ α] : α := One₁.one

@[inherit_doc]
notation "𝟙" => One₁.one

-- theorem C07_S01_2{α : Type} [One₁ α] : α := 𝟙

theorem C07_S01_3{α : Type} [One₁ α] : (𝟙 : α) = 𝟙 := rfl


class Dia₁ (α : Type) where
  dia : α → α → α

infixl:70 " ⋄ "   => Dia₁.dia


class Semigroup₁ (α : Type) where
  toDia₁ : Dia₁ α
  /-- Diamond is associative -/
  dia_assoc : ∀ a b c : α, a ⋄ b ⋄ c = a ⋄ (b ⋄ c)


attribute [instance] Semigroup₁.toDia₁

-- theorem C07_S01_4{α : Type} [Semigroup₁ α] (a b : α) : α := a ⋄ b


class Semigroup₂ (α : Type) extends Dia₁ α where
  /-- Diamond is associative -/
  dia_assoc : ∀ a b c : α, a ⋄ b ⋄ c = a ⋄ (b ⋄ c)

-- theorem C07_S01_5{α : Type} [Semigroup₂ α] (a b : α) : α := a ⋄ b

class DiaOneClass₁ (α : Type) extends One₁ α, Dia₁ α where
  /-- One is a left neutral element for diamond. -/
  one_dia : ∀ a : α, 𝟙 ⋄ a = a
  /-- One is a right neutral element for diamond -/
  dia_one : ∀ a : α, a ⋄ 𝟙 = a



set_option trace.Meta.synthInstance true in

class Monoid₂ (α : Type) where
  toSemigroup₁ : Semigroup₁ α
  toDiaOneClass₁ : DiaOneClass₁ α


theorem C07_S01_7{α : Type} [Monoid₁ α] :
  (Monoid₁.toSemigroup₁.toDia₁.dia : α → α → α) = Monoid₁.toDiaOneClass₁.toDia₁.dia := rfl

#check Monoid₁.mk

class Inv₁ (α : Type) where
  /-- The inversion function -/
  inv : α → α

@[inherit_doc]
postfix:max "⁻¹" => Inv₁.inv

class Group₁ (G : Type) extends Monoid₁ G, Inv₁ G where
  inv_dia : ∀ a : G, a⁻¹ ⋄ a = 𝟙


lemma left_inv_eq_right_inv₁ {M : Type} [Monoid₁ M] {a b c : M} (hba : b ⋄ a = 𝟙) (hac : a ⋄ c = 𝟙) : b = c := by
  rw [← DiaOneClass₁.one_dia c, ← hba, Semigroup₁.dia_assoc, hac, DiaOneClass₁.dia_one b]


export DiaOneClass₁ (one_dia dia_one)
export Semigroup₁ (dia_assoc)
export Group₁ (inv_dia)


theorem C07_S01_8{M : Type} [Monoid₁ M] {a b c : M} (hba : b ⋄ a = 𝟙) (hac : a ⋄ c = 𝟙) : b = c := by
  rw [← one_dia c, ← hba, dia_assoc, hac, dia_one b]


lemma inv_eq_of_dia [Group₁ G] {a b : G} (h : a ⋄ b = 𝟙) : a⁻¹ = b :=
  left_inv_eq_right_inv₁ (inv_dia a) h

lemma dia_inv [Group₁ G] (a : G) : a ⋄ a⁻¹ = 𝟙 :=
  by rw [← inv_dia a⁻¹, inv_eq_of_dia (inv_dia a)]

  rw [← DiaOneClass₁.one_dia c, ← hba, Semigroup₁.dia_assoc, hac, DiaOneClass₁.dia_one b]

  one_dia : ∀ a : α, 𝟙 ⋄ a = a

  dia_one : ∀ a : α, a ⋄ 𝟙 = a

class Group₁ (G : Type) extends Monoid₁ G, Inv₁ G where
  inv_dia : ∀ a : G, a⁻¹ ⋄ a = 𝟙


lemma left_inv_eq_right_inv₁ {M : Type} [Monoid₁ M] {a b c : M} (hba : b ⋄ a = 𝟙) (hac : a ⋄ c = 𝟙) : b = c := by
  rw [← DiaOneClass₁.one_dia c, ← hba, Semigroup₁.dia_assoc, hac, DiaOneClass₁.dia_one b]


export DiaOneClass₁ (one_dia dia_one)
export Semigroup₁ (dia_assoc)

theorem C07_S01_8{M : Type} [Monoid₁ M] {a b c : M} (hba : b ⋄ a = 𝟙) (hac : a ⋄ c = 𝟙) : b = c := by
  rw [← one_dia c, ← hba, dia_assoc, hac, dia_one b]


lemma inv_eq_of_dia [Group₁ G] {a b : G} (h : a ⋄ b = 𝟙) : a⁻¹ = b :=
  left_inv_eq_right_inv₁ (inv_dia a) h

lemma dia_inv [Group₁ G] (a : G) : a ⋄ a⁻¹ = 𝟙 :=
  by rw [← inv_dia a⁻¹, inv_eq_of_dia (inv_dia a)]

lemma left_inv_eq_right_inv₁ {M : Type} [Monoid₁ M] {a b c : M} (hba : b ⋄ a = 𝟙) (hac : a ⋄ c = 𝟙) : b = c := by
  rw [← DiaOneClass₁.one_dia c, ← hba, Semigroup₁.dia_assoc, hac, DiaOneClass₁.dia_one b]

theorem C07_S01_8{M : Type} [Monoid₁ M] {a b c : M} (hba : b ⋄ a = 𝟙) (hac : a ⋄ c = 𝟙) : b = c := by
  rw [← one_dia c, ← hba, dia_assoc, hac, dia_one b]


lemma inv_eq_of_dia [Group₁ G] {a b : G} (h : a ⋄ b = 𝟙) : a⁻¹ = b :=
  left_inv_eq_right_inv₁ (inv_dia a) h

lemma dia_inv [Group₁ G] (a : G) : a ⋄ a⁻¹ = 𝟙 :=
  by rw [← inv_dia a⁻¹, inv_eq_of_dia (inv_dia a)]

lemma inv_eq_of_dia [Group₁ G] {a b : G} (h : a ⋄ b = 𝟙) : a⁻¹ = b :=

  by rw [← inv_dia a⁻¹, inv_eq_of_dia (inv_dia a)]

C1_dependencies.content:
/--
`rfl : a = a` is the unique constructor of the equality type. This is the
same as `Eq.refl` except that it takes `a` implicitly instead of explicitly.

This is a more powerful theorem than it may appear at first, because although
the statement of the theorem is `a = a`, Lean will allow anything that is
definitionally equal to that type. So, for instance, `2 + 2 = 4` is proven in
Lean by `rfl`, because both sides are the same up to definitional equality.
-/
@[match_pattern] def rfl {α : Sort u} {a : α} : Eq a a := Eq.refl a

/--
`rfl : a = a` is the unique constructor of the equality type. This is the
same as `Eq.refl` except that it takes `a` implicitly instead of explicitly.

This is a more powerful theorem than it may appear at first, because although
the statement of the theorem is `a = a`, Lean will allow anything that is
definitionally equal to that type. So, for instance, `2 + 2 = 4` is proven in
Lean by `rfl`, because both sides are the same up to definitional equality.
-/
@[match_pattern] def rfl {α : Sort u} {a : α} : Eq a a := Eq.refl a
